title: Instagram, Facebook Ran AI ‘Nudify’ Ads from China, Report Says
title_zh: 报告称 Instagram、Facebook 运行人工智能“裸化”来自中国的广告
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc.’s Facebook and Instagram have served thousands of ads for AI “nudify” apps in breach of the company’s policies, delivered by one of its few advertising partners in China, according to the nonprofit Tech Transparency Project.Most Read from Blo...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——非营利性技术透明项目称，Meta Platforms Inc. 的 Facebook 和 Instagram 已为人工智能“裸体”应用程序提供了数千个广告，违反了该公司的政策，这些广告是由该公司在中国为数不多的广告合作伙伴之一提供的。

title: China’s Moonshot to Release Breakthrough AI Model for Download
title_zh: 中国登月计划将发布突破性人工智能模型供下载
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Moonshot AI is poised to make its Kimi K3 model available for public download, expanding its reach and influence in the global open software community at a time of growing US concern about Chinese encroachment into the top echelons of AI development.Most Read fr...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Moonshot AI 准备向公众提供其 Kimi K3 模型，以扩大其在全球开放软件社区的影响力和影响力，目前美国对中国蚕食人工智能开发高层的担忧日益加剧。

title: Nvidia in talks with OpenAI to guarantee $250 billion financing for data center, WSJ reports
title_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Nvidia 正在与 OpenAI 进行谈判，以保证为数据中心提供 2500 亿美元的融资
summary: Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the ‌Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday.
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》周日报道，Nvidia 正在洽谈为 OpenAI 提供约 2500 亿美元的融资担保，作为大型数据中心项目的一部分。

title: 'The AI trade is still on': Wall Street sees Big Tech's spending as positive for semiconductor stocks
title_zh: “人工智能交易仍在继续”：华尔街认为大型科技公司的支出对半导体股票有利
summary: Alphabet's increased capex forecast for 2026 this week was the latest tailwind for AI infrastructure stocks.
summary_zh: Alphabet 本周上调了 2026 年资本支出预测，这是人工智能基础设施股的最新推动力。

title: Corporate America is the most optimistic it's been in 15 years — but the market's still stuck: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 美国企业界正处于 15 年来最乐观的时期，但市场仍然停滞不前：每日图表
summary: More S&P 500 companies are raising their profit outlooks than cutting them — a setup that would normally lead to a stock market rally that hasn't come.
summary_zh: 更多的标普 500 指数成分股公司正在上调利润预期，而不是下调利润预期——这种情况通常会导致股市反弹，但实际上并没有出现。

title: 4 Big Tech earnings reports, a Fed meeting, and $100 oil: It's the busiest week of the quarter
title_zh: 四大科技公司财报、美联储会议和 100 美元油价：这是本季度最繁忙的一周
summary: Investors step into the busiest week of the quarter with hyperscaler earnings, the June Fed meeting, and escalations in the Middle East all in focus.
summary_zh: 投资者进入本季度最繁忙的一周，超大规模盈利、六月美联储会议以及中东局势升级都是焦点。
